comment: Which GRUB security fixes (and other fixes we depend on, type 'defect') our source-built GRUB contains, and the SBAT generation they earn. build/grub/grubsrc.py proves each fix present by applying its upstream commit (build/grub/upstream/<commit>.patch) IN REVERSE, as a dry run with no fuzz, to the fully patched source tree: that only succeeds when the fixed code is there. If a fix that a claim requires is missing, the GRUB build fails. 'files' limits a check to the hunks for files that exist in 2.14. Generations up to grub,5 are Ubuntu's own claim for this source (debian/sbat.ubuntu.csv.in).

sbat_claims.level_source: https://github.com/rhboot/shim/blob/main/SbatLevel_Variable.txt (added by shim commit 8947f069aca02aad6181af202eda6088c9cfb44d 'sbat: bump for November Grub CVEs')
sbat_claims.level_text: Revocations for: - November 2025 grub CVEs (CVE-2025-54770/54771, CVE-2025-61661/61662/61663/61664) sbat,1,2025112400 shim,4 grub,6
sbat_claims.upstream: GNU GRUB 2.16 sets GLOBAL_SBAT_LEVEL=6 for the same push (commit 99ab9d04b5d7daf6b942221825b816ecd40801d4); announcement '[SECURITY PATCH 0/8]' https://lists.gnu.org/archive/html/grub-devel/2025-11/msg00155.html (2025-11-18)

not_claimed.why: shim PR https://github.com/rhboot/shim/pull/830 (open, not merged) proposes sbat,1,2026092500 shim,4 grub,7 for CVE-2026-97876; GRUB MR https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/gnu-grub/grub/-/merge_requests/295 (open) the matching bump. We carry the fix (patches/0001) but keep grub,6 until shim publishes that level.

fixes.summary: kern/file: use-after-free in grub_file_close() (grub_dl_unref() ran before fs->fs_close())
net/net: use-after-free, net_set_vlan command not unregistered on module unload
gettext: use-after-free, gettext command not unregistered on module unload
normal/main: use-after-free, normal command not unregistered on module unload
normal/main: use-after-free, normal_exit command not unregistered on module unload (same commit as CVE-2025-61663)
commands/usbtest: out-of-bounds write in grub_usb_get_string() (wrong string length field)
commands/usbtest: ensure the string length is sufficient (hardening that completes CVE-2025-61661; patch 8/8 of the push)
commands/test: fix the recursion depth calculation (patch 1/8 of the push, no CVE)
tests/lib/functional_test: unregister commands on module unload (patch 6/8 of the push, no CVE)
term/serial: the serial command accepted caller-supplied I/O port / MMIO base addresses under lockdown (memory write primitive, lockdown / Secure Boot bypass for whoever controls grub.cfg)

efi/sb: GRUB could not boot kernels after `mokutil --disable-validation` (shim protocols not looked up when MokSBState says insecure, kernel handed to firmware LoadImage); no CVE, needed with shim 16's image loader

efi/peimage: 'error: trying to register different loader.' on every Secure Boot boot with shim 16 (peimage registered a second EFI loader after GRUB registered shim's image loader); peimage now registers only when shim offers no loader protocol (shim 15.x), and unregisters only what it registered
fixes.sbat: none (not a security fix; grub.peimage unchanged)
fixes.where: build/grub/patches/0003-efi-peimage-only-register-loader-when-shim-loader-protocol-absent.patch (Debian's change, applied to the patched peimage.c)
